company.name: Meridian Cars & Chauffeur Ltd
company.description: Licensed private hire and Hackney carriage operator headquartered at Trafford Park, Manchester, with satellite dispatch bases in Leeds and Birmingham. Runs a mixed fleet of metered private hire saloons and estates, wheelchair-accessible vehicles (WAV), executive chauffeur saloons and stretch limousines. Holds a private hire operator's licence with Transport for Greater Manchester (TfGM) and a Hackney carriage proprietor's licence with Leeds City Council. Dispatches through an in-house metered booking and fare platform with live GPS availability, serving corporate accounts, airport transfers (Manchester, Leeds Bradford, Birmingham), school contract runs and event chauffeuring across the North West and Midlands.

metadata.generatedNote: Realistic fully-local UK example dataset reflecting a typical operating week (2026-06-22 to 2026-06-28) for a small licensed private hire and Hackney carriage operator across Greater Manchester, Leeds and Birmingham. Reflects DVSA MOT and licensing-authority compliance testing; private hire / Hackney carriage operator and vehicle licensing under the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976 and the Town Police Clauses Act 1847; DVLA driver licensing; enhanced DBS disclosure; driver badge and vehicle plate regimes; fare metering and dispatch; ratings and bookings; and Clean Air Zone / ULEZ compliance. Currency is GBP (pound sterling). All personal data, registration marks, plate numbers and licence references are fictitious.

notes.author: Dispatch Controller
notes.body: Senior partner requested the executive saloon with privacy glass and bottled water. Confirmed two-hour on-call waiting allowance billed at the chauffeur hourly rate during court proceedings in Liverpool.

notes.author: Compliance Officer
notes.body: Reminder issued: private hire driver badge TFGM-PHD-42008 expires 31 July 2026. Renewal application and medical must be submitted to TfGM at least four weeks before expiry to avoid suspension from dispatch.

notes.author: Workshop Foreman
notes.body: Limousine taken off-road after the pre-MOT check found the offside rear brake disc below minimum thickness. Discs and pads ordered; vehicle not to be dispatched until re-tested and the licensing-authority compliance test is passed.

notes.author: WAV Driver
notes.body: Patient secured with 4-point clamp and occupant restraint; escort accompanied. Outpatient clinic at Leeds General Infirmary ran approximately ten minutes late, so the return collection was delayed accordingly.

notes.author: Customer Care
notes.body: Gold-tier app member travels with an assistance dog. Flagged on all bookings so drivers are aware of their Equality Act 2010 duty to carry assistance dogs without surcharge or refusal.

notes.author: Events Coordinator
notes.body: Wedding limousine booking for Saturday confirmed. White ribbon and bow to be fitted at the depot before departure. Couple requested a non-alcoholic option in the bar console. Balance of GBP 295 to be collected on arrival at Hollins Hall.

notes.author: Telematics Analyst
notes.body: Brief speeding alert recorded on the M56 (76 mph in a 70 limit) during the early-hours airport run. Spoken to the driver; advised to keep within limits even on quiet motorway sections. No further action required.

notes.author: Dispatch Controller
notes.body: Driver waited the full free-waiting period before marking the job as a no-show. No-show fee of GBP 4 applied to the Pennine Tech account in line with the corporate terms.

notes.author: Workshop Foreman
notes.body: Fare meter TXM-44210 calibration certificate on file and valid. Next calibration check scheduled to coincide with the next service to minimise vehicle downtime.

notes.author: Operations Manager
notes.body: Chauffeur holds RoSPA Advanced Driving Gold and consistently scores above 4.9 on passenger ratings. Preferred driver for Northgate Legal corporate account and VIP airport meet-and-greet duties.

notes.author: Airport Dispatcher
notes.body: VIP arrival from Doha on QR23. Driver allocated the airport pick-up permit and will wait in the arrivals hall with a Bridgewater Hotel name board. Two large cases expected.

notes.author: Telematics Analyst
notes.body: Diesel particulate filter completed an active regeneration on 21 June, soot dropping from 62% to 4%. Encouraging the Birmingham driver to include a longer motorway leg weekly to keep the DPF healthy.

notes.author: Chauffeur
notes.body: Court session over-running. Partner expected to be ready around 13:00 for the return leg to Manchester. Holding in the executive saloon at the designated waiting bay.
